headline: Full 8-ball physics in pure vanilla JS with zero ads
text:
Full 8-ball physics with realistic cue spin, cushion deflection, and called pockets—built in a single HTML file.

No downloads. Zero ads. Instant 0.1s load.

Rack 'em up: https://kreeda.games/break-room/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiegame
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second seamless looping GIF/clip showing a smooth draw-shot (backspin) on the cue ball banking off a cushion and sinking the 8-ball into a called pocket.
